main_answer_reason: Despite substantial correctly attributed lower-court analysis and unresolved appellate posture, the report wrongly identifies the appellant as counsel Daryadatta Chawla and reverses the school-record 'sala' relation; it also overstates section 50's rejection of documentary context.
